port_instructions: Patcher (ARM): constants EXPECTED_SHA256=b01d5f1237d2daad8cc076d7218f0788751b55a9576c779ccdba08eef6fcfcf8; file length must be 0x1680A00; asserts: file[0x156:0x158]==22 01, DllCharacteristics@0x19E==0x9140, OS/subsys versions 6.2, 7 sections, SizeOfHeaders 0x400, import dir (0x13269A8,0x3FC) with exactly 50 descriptors, zero bytes at file 0xC362A0..0xC36400.

Write order (reference implementation: arm32/facts/winmain_verify.py::build): (1) DllCharacteristics 0x9140->0x8140 at 0x19E; (2) in-place renames vccorlib140_app.DLL@0x1328CDE, MSVCP140_APP.dll@0x132C3C8, CONCRT140_APP.dll@0x132CD0A, VCRUNTIME140_APP.dll@0x132CE36 (each exactly 1 occurrence, NUL padded); (3) build .d3imp (vsize 0x444, raw 0x600) at file 0x1680A00 / RVA 0x1730000; (4) header: NumberOfSections 8, SizeOfInitializedData 0xAF5800->0xAF5E00, SizeOfImage 0x1730000->0x1731000, dd[1]=(0x1730000,0x410), section header at file 0x350; (5) trampoline bytes `dff808c0 fc44 dcf800c0 6047 9495af00` at file 0xC362A0 (RVA 0xC36EA0); (6) call site file 0xB48ECA: `00f0abfc` -> `edf0e9f9`.

Do NOT port: LAA write (already set), OS/subsystem minor 2->1, DYNAMIC_BASE clearing, KERNEL32 ILT placeholders + 4 compat descriptors, api-set/dxgi/d3d11 descriptor redirects, fmod_X86->fmod rename, the 12-byte `ff 15 <abs> 90*6` patch, the `0x10293A2` file offset and 27/0x230 import checks.

Win32Bootstrap: `extern "C" int Win32Bootstrap(void)`, exported undecorated; first statement keeps `GetModuleHandleW(NULL)`; compare SizeOfImage (image+e_lfanew+0x50) to 0x01731000; must return (WM_QUIT wParam) so exit(r4) runs. Do not assume ImageBase==0x400000 (DYNAMIC_BASE stays set).
Host IAT/vtable patching writes into .rdata cells: always VirtualProtect(PAGE_READWRITE) + restore + FlushInstructionCache, resolving cells by name (see host.iat_cells_used_in_bootstrap).
Delete from the ARM host: all non-1.2.8 branches, Windows-7 shims, x86 CONTEXT-based crash dump (rewrite for ARM CONTEXT), `thiscall/fastcall/stdcall` typedefs (plain AAPCS).
open_questions: Target OS runtime requirements are outside the PE patch: the exe imports api-ms-win-crt-* (UCRT) and api-ms-win-core-* sets; Windows 10 ARM32 has them inbox, Windows RT 8.1 does not ship UCRT.
